rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice when someone is set free or let out.

example.english: The police release him after questioning.
example.traditional: 啲差人問完佢之後就放佢出嚟喇。
example.jyutping: di1 caai1 jan4 man6 jyun4 keoi5 zi1 hau6 zau6 fong3 keoi5 ceot1 lei4 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a newly released or upgraded software version rather than the act of distributing it.

example.english: This new release is finally out, so everyone can update.
example.traditional: 呢個新版本終於出咗，大家可以更新喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 baan2 bun2 zung1 jyu1 ceot1 zo2 daai6 gaa1 ho2 ji5 gang1 san1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for launching a new product, service, film, or other item for public use.

example.english: The company will release its new app next month.
example.traditional: 間公司下個月推出新手機程式。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 teoi1 ceot1 san1 sau2 gei1 cing4 sik1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the freeing of prisoners, hostages, animals, or restrained mechanisms.

example.english: The court announced the release of all the hostages.
example.traditional: 法庭宣布釋放所有人質。
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 syun1 bou3 sik1 fong3 so2 jau5 jan4 zat1

rows.note: Use this for newly available goods or products put on sale, including newly arrived shop stock.

example.english: This new release just arrived, and it won't be for sale until tomorrow.
example.traditional: 呢批新貨啱啱返到，聽日先有得賣。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 san1 fo3 ngaam1 ngaam1 faan1 dou3 ting1 jat6 sin1 jau5 dak1 maai6

rows.note: Use this when releasing your hold on an object or letting go of something you are holding.

example.jyutping: nei5 fong3 hoi1 tiu4 sing4 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for relief understood as freedom from pain or suffering, especially after prolonged distress.

example.english: After enduring pain for so long, they finally found release from their suffering.
example.traditional: 捱咗咁耐病痛，佢終於得到解脫。
example.jyutping: ngaai4 zo2 gam3 noi6 beng6 tung3 keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou2 gaai2 tyut3

rows.note: Use this for deliberately discharging water, gas, waste, or other substances into the environment.

example.english: The factory's daily release of waste gas must be strictly monitored.
example.traditional: 工廠每日排放嘅廢氣，都要經過嚴格監測。
example.jyutping: gung1 cong2 mui5 jat6 paai4 fong3 ge3 fai3 hei3 dou1 jiu3 ging1 gwo3 jim4 gaak3 gaam1 cak1
